response.text:
Two of your documents expire in the next six months:

File your extension application with the Ausländerbehörde [party:pty_7jmdemeegmw0] at or before the appointment and before this date — if you do, the permit usually keeps counting as valid until the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG); ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- **Passport** – expires Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse]. Renewing can take months, and note that a residence permit usually only runs as long as the passport does, so it's worth renewing in good time [item:itm_86khkd0zfcse].

I didn't find any other expiring documents or permits (e.g. Steuer-ID, health/social insurance, student registration, Rundfunkbeitrag) in your records with a due date in this window.
